snippet.description:
➡️ Join Samuel Leeds' FREE Online Property Training: https://www.samuelleeds.com/freetraining

The UK housing crisis has just got worse, and barely anyone is talking about what this could mean for landlords, tenants, homeowners and property investors.

In this video, I break down why Keir Starmer’s resignation, Andy Burnham’s likely rise to Prime Minister, Labour’s housing failures, stamp duty changes, rent controls, land tax proposals and the collapse of confidence in the UK property market could completely reshape the future of housing in Britain.

The government promised 1.5 million new homes, leasehold reform, easier planning permission and a fairer housing system. Instead, we are seeing rising rents, landlords leaving the market, first-time buyers struggling, developers being squeezed, social housing demand increasing and big institutions moving in.

Whether the market goes up, down or sideways, educated property investors can still win if they understand where the tide is moving.
